rows.grounds: sandhi fusion trasareṇuḥ + aṣṭaguṇau; eightfold measure of the minute dust-mote
sandhi fusion rathareṇuḥ + tu; the chariot-dust unit

items.question: What quantity of minute dust-motes defines the unit called chariot-dust?
premises: A minute dust-mote is the basic measure.
Eightfold minute dust-motes form a larger unit.
That larger unit is called chariot-dust.
items.inference: Therefore, a chariot-dust is defined as eight minute dust-motes.
uncertainties: The exact grammatical analysis of trasareṇuraṣṭaguṇau as dual or a fused measure expression is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Eight minute dust-motes are traditionally known as one chariot-dust.
